pe_assessment: Vendor trailing46.28x versus forward19.38x; GAAP trailing includes acquisition amortisation and forward is an estimate. Rapid observed earnings/FCF growth makes forward valuation plausible, not guaranteed. No single-quarter EPS annualisation is treated as TTM.
margin_analysis: Q3 operating margin=15.955/29.591=53.92% GAAP; adjusted20.095/29.591=67.91%. Non-GAAP excludes SBC, acquired amortisation and other costs; adjusted earnings are not cash.
debt_analysis: Stated debt$2.252bn+$57.167bn=$59.419bn versus cash$23.975bn, net debt$35.444bn excluding leases. Q3 CFO$14.197bn less PP&E$0.532bn=FCF$13.665bn; operating income/interest$0.778bn=20.51x.
growth_outlook: Q3 revenue+86%, GAAP operating income+171%, FCF+95%; AI revenue$16.7bn +221%. Q4$34.8bn guidance is prospective.
key_risks: Customer concentration and possible AI-capex slowdown can impair the growth-supported valuation.
Debt remains material; GAAP/non-GAAP gap includes recurring SBC, and Q3 FCF should not be multiplied by4 as a forecast.
key_strengths: Cash generation validates a large part of reported profitability.
Net debt is material but interest coverage and declining stated debt provide capacity.
summary: Broadcom earns a buy view from accelerating revenue, strong cash conversion and manageable observed financing burden. Medium confidence reflects concentrated AI demand and reliance on continued growth for valuation upside.
